title: ProfBench: Multi-Domain Rubrics requiring Professional Knowledge to Answer and Judge
authors_zh: Zhilin Wang, Jaehun Jung, Ximing Lu, Shizhe Diao, Ellie Evans, Jiaqi Zeng, Pavlo Molchanov, Yejin Choi, Jan Kautz, Yi Dong
paper_type_zh: 多专业领域的回答与 Judge rubric 基准
best_for_zh: 需要训练或比较专业报告 Judge、奖励模型和长文本回答系统的研究者。
one_line: ProfBench pairs professional prompts and grounding documents with expert response-rubric supervision across four domains.
ProfBench 为科学、金融和咨询报告提供专家撰写的细粒度准则，可同时评估回答模型与 Judge。
why: It extends rubric-based evaluation beyond domains with easily verified answers.
inclusion_reason: ProfBench releases expert supervision for both generating and judging professional long-form work.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Physics research, chemistry analysis, finance, and consulting reports admit many valid formulations and require professional expertise to answer and judge. General judge benchmarks lack this expertise barrier, allowing fluency or self-preference to inflate scores, while fully human evaluation is expensive.

ProfBench has professionals in four domains author tasks and criteria and studies lower-cost LLM judges that mitigate self-enhancement bias when evaluating professional materials and reports.

物理研究、化学分析、金融和咨询报告往往包含多种合理表述，需要专业人士才能同时回答和评判。通用 Judge 基准缺少高专业门槛，模型可能依靠流畅度或自我偏好取得高分，而纯人工评测成本又难以扩展。

ProfBench 用四类专业人士编写问题和准则，并研究低成本 LLM Judge 如何减少自增强偏差，以评估模型处理专业材料和综合报告的能力。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: ProfBench releases 40 professional tasks, each with 15–59 criteria, and forms more than 7,000 expert response–criterion evaluations from multiple model answers. It covers Physics PhD, Chemistry PhD, Finance MBA, and Consulting MBA domains. The authors also develop efficient LLM judges that mitigate self-enhancement bias and reduce cost by two to three orders of magnitude, supporting professional-response evaluation and judge calibration.
ProfBench 公开 40 个专业任务，每题含 15–59 条准则，并通过多模型回答形成 7,000 余组“回答—判据”专家评价，覆盖物理博士、化学博士、金融 MBA 和咨询 MBA。作者同时构建去自增强偏差的高效 LLM Judge，将评测成本降低 2–3 个数量级；数据可用于专业回答评测和 Judge 校准。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Design tasks: Experts from four domains create tasks requiring document processing, synthesis, and report generation with context files.
  1. Author rubrics: Experts decompose answer quality into 15–59 criteria covering facts, derivations, completeness, and deliverables.
  1. Collect labels: Several models generate responses, and experts judge compliance criterion by criterion, producing more than 7K pairs.
  1. Calibrate judges: Answerer and judge roles, prompts, and model combinations are adjusted to reduce self-enhancement bias; response pools and cost settings must be fixed.

1. 设计任务： 四类专家提出需要处理材料、综合信息和形成报告的问题，并提供背景文件。
  1. 编写 rubric： 专家将答案质量拆为 15–59 条专业准则，包含事实、推导、覆盖度和交付要求。
  1. 收集评价： 多个模型生成回答，专家逐条判断是否满足准则，形成 7K+ pair。
  1. 校准 Judge： 通过分离回答者与评判者、调整提示和模型组合降低自增强偏差；复现需固定答案池和成本设置。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The leading GPT-5-high reaches only 65.9% overall, with a clear proprietary–open-weight gap and domain-dependent benefits from additional thinking. The judge setup remains close to expert judgments while reducing cost by two to three orders of magnitude. Professional rubrics therefore create meaningful difficulty, but the public set has only 40 tasks, so small ranking differences should not be overinterpreted.
顶尖 GPT-5-high 的总体表现也只有 65.9%，专有模型与开源模型之间存在明显差距，增加思考预算的收益因专业领域而异。作者的 Judge 方案在接近专家判断的同时将成本降低 2–3 个数量级。结果说明专业 rubric 形成有效难度，但公开数据只有 40 个任务，细微排名差别不宜过度解释。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier rubric benchmarks focus on everyday chat or general instructions, where expertise is mainly needed for answering. ProfBench has experts define tasks and provide criterion labels while explicitly studying self-enhancement bias. Its contribution is the combination of professional knowledge requirements and judge-calibration data, not a new professional foundation model.
既有 rubric 基准多覆盖日常聊天或通用指令，专业知识通常只用于回答。ProfBench 让领域专家既定义任务又提供逐判据标签，并显式研究回答模型评判自身时的自增强偏差。贡献是专业知识要求和 Judge 校准数据的结合，而不是新的专业基础模型。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: Only 40 high-cost tasks are included, giving depth but substantial sampling variance.
  1. Limitation 2: MBA and PhD standards may encode particular educational and industry conventions.
  1. Limitation 3: Lower-cost judges may retain model-family preferences and cannot fully replace experts.

1. 局限1： 仅 40 个高成本任务，领域覆盖虽深但样本方差较大。
  1. 局限2： MBA 与博士专家标准可能反映特定教育和行业习惯。
  1. 局限3： 低成本 Judge 仍可能继承模型家族偏好，不能完全替代专家。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Compare professional-report generation and report results separately for four domains.
  1. Use case 2: Use more than 7K expert labels to train pointwise judges and measure self-enhancement bias.
  1. Use case 3: Do not directly extrapolate to medical, legal, or country-specific standards.

1. 使用场景1： 比较模型生成专业报告的能力，并按四个领域分别报告。
  1. 使用场景2： 用 7K+ 专家判定训练 pointwise Judge，重点测自增强偏差。
  1. 使用场景3： 医疗、法律或国家规范任务不能从四个领域直接外推。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Professional criteria test both answering and judging.
  2. Method: Forty tasks, 15–59 rubrics per task, multiple responses, and expert labels.
  3. Data: More than 7K response–criterion pairs across four PhD/MBA domains.
  4. Evidence: GPT-5-high reaches 65.9%; judge cost drops by 2–3 orders.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for professional judges; small-sample rankings need uncertainty.

1. 一句话定位： 用专业人士准则同时测试模型能否回答和判断。
  2. 方法抓手： 40 任务、15–59 条/题 rubric、多模型回答和专家标签。
  3. 数据抓手： 7K+ response–criterion pair，覆盖四类博士/MBA 专业。
  4. 证据锚点： GPT-5-high 仅 65.9%，Judge 成本降 2–3 个数量级。
  5. 复用决定： 适合专业 Judge；小样本排名须附不确定性。
